flags.affected: All-in total for every route and tier
flags.why: No executable rate, correspondent/receiving fee, personal tax basis or future rate was published.
flags.discover: Request a written executable quote and full fee breakdown from both banks; document tax basis; leave blank until confirmed.

flags.affected: Source, tax-paid status and 完税证明 for this balance
flags.why: No account documents were supplied; the official rules require lawful-source and tax evidence.
flags.discover: Obtain statements, contracts and an official tax certificate; ask the bank for its written checklist.

flags.affected: Personal immigration/residence/PR-card/hukou status
flags.why: Eligibility for quota, documented-income, emigrant and inheritance routes depends on private status facts.
flags.discover: Assemble passport, day count, residence permit, PR card and hukou-cancellation evidence; ask the bank/SAFE to classify in writing.

flags.affected: BOC board timestamp 21:00:05 versus 20:39:19
flags.why: The USD row stayed the same between the two same-day readings while the timestamp advanced; the board says it is for reference only and the actual transaction rate governs.
flags.discover: Capture the exact board timestamp with any quote; use the bank's actual transaction rate for execution.

flags.affected: HSBC board last updated 2026-11-10
flags.why: It is dated before the BOC board and is subject to change without notice.
flags.discover: Ask HSBC for a same-day executable rate before comparing routes.

flags.affected: HSBC PDF has two effective-date headers
flags.why: The cover says one date while embedded table headers say another; the applicable version should be confirmed with the bank.
flags.discover: Ask HSBC to confirm the effective tariff for your account and retain the written answer.

flags.affected: BOC local/promotional discounts
flags.why: The official fee schedule links to a promotion page that now returns a 404; local/agreement differences are acknowledged but not published.
flags.discover: Ask the branch for its current local price list and any written discount; leave blank until supplied.

flags.affected: Wise exact fee, conversion rate and personal overall limit
flags.why: The provider says to set up a transfer to see exact fees and computes an overall limit from private income/tax records.
flags.discover: Use the official setup screen without funding; capture the quoted fee/rate and the assigned limit; do not infer them here.

flags.affected: Bank FX rate and wire fee for emigrant/inheritance transfers
flags.why: The SAFE guide publishes no administrative fee but not the bank's conversion rate or remittance charges.
flags.discover: After approval, ask the designated bank for a written rate and full fee schedule.

flags.affected: Foreign ATM-owner fee, network FX rate, cash deposit/conversion cost
flags.why: Only the PRC cap and one issuer's ATM fee are published.
flags.discover: Ask the card issuer and foreign ATM owner for written fees/rate; keep withdrawal receipts.

flags.affected: Cash-permit fee, security, insurance and U.S. deposit/conversion cost
flags.why: The official cash rules publish limits and permits, not these costs.
flags.discover: Ask the bank for permit charges and the U.S. bank for cash-deposit terms; do not carry unverified amounts.

flags.affected: Direct cross-border RMB route for an accumulated balance
flags.why: PBOC supports current-account RMB settlement but does not publish a general personal savings/capital route, fee, limit or rate.
flags.discover: Request written legal basis, purpose, tariff, limit and rate from the bank and SAFE; leave blank otherwise.

flags.affected: Personal PRC income-tax bill and overdue-tax exposure
flags.why: Residence, income type, deductions and payment history are unknown.
flags.discover: Give source documents and tax records to a qualified PRC tax professional; obtain written clearance where needed.

flags.affected: Acquisition basis, personal-transaction status and U.S. ordinary tax rate
flags.why: §988 publishes character and a $200 threshold, not your basis or bracket.
flags.discover: Reconstruct acquisition dates/rates and provide them with your U.S. return data to a tax professional.

flags.affected: Prior FBAR, Form 8938, Form 3520 and CBP filing history
flags.why: No private filing history was provided; penalties depend on facts and willfulness.
flags.discover: Obtain IRS transcripts and prior filings; list every foreign account and annual maximum; seek professional correction advice.

flags.affected: FEIE/FTC eligibility and treaty position
flags.why: Tax home, abode, presence tests, foreign tax paid and treaty residence are private; the treaty text was not read line by line here.
flags.discover: Provide travel and tax records to a U.S. tax professional and consult the current treaty publication before claiming relief.

flags.affected: eCFR penalty table amendment history
flags.why: The display is current but the quoted amendment history ends with the 2025 Federal Register adjustment; a newer inflation amount was not seen on this page.
flags.discover: Check the annual FinCEN inflation-adjustment notice before quoting a penalty maximum.

flags.affected: Historical staged-emigrant wording
flags.why: PBOC 2004 Article 6 says staged remittance, but SAFE 2014 §VI abolished the staged requirement and HQ filing; older repository lines repeat the superseded wording.
flags.discover: Use the later SAFE rule; ask the approving SAFE office for its current checklist; correct only in the owning session's files.

flags.affected: Fed H.10 latest column versus same-day bank boards
flags.why: The weekly release's latest daily rate is dated before the BOC board; it is not a same-day executable rate.
flags.discover: Use a consistently applied posted rate for tax translation and record its date; do not mix it silently with a bank quote.

flags.affected: Bank authenticity-review outcome
flags.why: The law imposes a review duty; no bank has been asked about this balance.
flags.discover: Submit the document pack and obtain a written acceptance or a written list of deficiencies.

flags.affected: Numeric penalty for a proposed crypto/stablecoin conversion
flags.why: The official notice declares the activity illegal but refers to other rules for penalties.
flags.discover: Do not use the route; consult a PRC lawyer for the current enforcement provision if an exposure assessment is needed.

flags.affected: U.S.-side Global Transfer account terms
flags.why: The PRC tariff lists Canada, US, UK, Australia and Hong Kong SAR among applicable countries/regions for the family service, but the precise U.S. receiving-account terms and corridor details were not read line by line here.
flags.discover: Ask both HSBC entities to confirm corridor availability, account eligibility and charges in writing.

flags.affected: HSBC Premier monthly service fee in an all-route comparison
flags.why: The tariff publishes a monthly fee and balance/promotion criteria, but the per-transfer cost excludes it because personal segment and waiver status are unknown.
flags.discover: Ask HSBC which segment applies and whether the monthly fee is waived; add it only after a written answer.
